  "title": "General Manager",
  "description": "MTN Nigeria - The leader in telecommunications in Nigeria, and a part of a diverse community in Africa and the Middle East, our brand is instantly recognisable. It is through our compelling brand that we are able to attract the right talents who we carefully nurture by continuously improving our employment offerings even beyond reward and recognition.

We are&nbsp;recruiting for the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: General Manager - Regulatory Affairs&nbsp;

Job Identification: 7749
Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Chief Corporate Services and Sustainability Officer - CCSSO
Division: Corporate Services and Sustainability

Mission


	To provide MTNN with proactive, integrated and future-facing regulatory strategy, policy advocacy and regulatory risk management in line with MTN&rsquo;s business plan, Group priorities, Nigeria&rsquo;s digital economy agenda and evolving telecommunications, technology, data, cybersecurity, satellite and artificial intelligence developments.


Description


	Provide technical leadership/advice in the formulation and development of framework, policies and guidelines and ensure compliance of operations with MTNN policies and procedures.
	Establish strategic direction for the regulatory affairs function in accordance with overall company strategy.
	Oversee and ensure compliance with interconnect, spectrum leasing, national roaming, virtual network operator and active network sharing agreements and all other regulated related issues in the industry.
	Provide thought leadership and advice on the creation/adoption of a framework to integrate business analysis and planning into MTNN&rsquo;s engagements and identify /create distinct competitive advantages for the organization through strategic use of information.
	Lead regulatory analysis, advocacy and advisory support on data privacy, data governance, cross-border data transfers, customer consent, digital identity and responsible use of customer information.
	Provide regulatory leadership on cybersecurity, critical information infrastructure, network resilience, incident reporting, fraud management and security-related obligations affecting telecom operations.
	Advise on artificial intelligence, algorithmic accountability, automated decision-making, AI-enabled customer service, AI-enabled network operations and emerging responsible AI governance frameworks.
	Provide regulatory oversight and business-enablement advice for API-based products, Open Gateway initiatives, interoperability frameworks, platform partnerships and digital ecosystem models.
	Monitor and shape regulatory developments on satellite communications, direct-to-device (D2D), non-terrestrial networks (NTN), spectrum coexistence, emergency connectivity and universal access implications.
	Advise on cloud services, data centres, edge computing, digital infrastructure regulation and technology sovereignty requirements affecting MTNN&rsquo;s business and partnerships.
	Coordinate cross-functional regulatory impact assessments for new products, services, technologies, partnerships, commercial models and strategic investments before launch or implementation.
	Negotiate interconnects agreements with incumbent operators and new entrants, reviewing interconnect agreements and capacity leasing agreements.
	Negotiate virtual network operator, spectrum leasing, national roaming and active network sharing contracts with other Licensees


Requirements
Education:


	LLB or other recognized law Degree
	First&nbsp; Degree in any relevant discipline&nbsp;
	Fluent in English and language of country preferable
	Masters in Business Admin/Masters in Law will be advantageous&nbsp;


Experience:
A Minimum 12 years of working experience which includes:


	Senior management track record of 3 years or more; with at least 3 years in relevant sector/ industry as per relevant role
	Experience working in a global/multinational enterprise (understanding emerging markets advantageous)
	Worked across diverse cultures and geographies
	Management experience in a commercial legal environment/ within a legal and regulatory control body
	Demonstrable exposure to emerging digital economy regulation, including data privacy, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, digital platforms, APIs, fintech, cloud or satellite communications.
	Experience engaging with senior regulators, government agencies, industry associations and cross-functional executive stakeholders on complex regulatory or public policy matters.

        MTN Nigeria - The leader in telecommunications in Nigeria, and a part of a diverse community in Africa and the Middle East, our brand is instantly recognisable. It is through our compelling brand that we are able to attract the right talents who we carefully nurture by continuously improving our employment offerings even beyond reward and recognition.

We are recruiting for the position below:

 Job Position: General Manager - Regulatory Affairs 

Job Identification: 7749
Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Chief Corporate Services and Sustainability Officer - CCSSO
Division: Corporate Services and Sustainability

Mission
     

            
    




	To provide MTNN with proactive, integrated and future-facing regulatory strategy, policy advocacy and regulatory risk management in line with MTN’s business plan, Group priorities, Nigeria’s digital economy agenda and evolving telecommunications, technology, data, cybersecurity, satellite and artificial intelligence developments.


Description


	Provide technical leadership/advice in the formulation and development of framework, policies and guidelines and ensure compliance of operations with MTNN policies and procedures.
	Establish strategic direction for the regulatory affairs function in accordance with overall company strategy.
	Oversee and ensure compliance with interconnect, spectrum leasing, national roaming, virtual network operator and active network sharing agreements and all other regulated related issues in the industry.
	Provide thought leadership and advice on the creation/adoption of a framework to integrate business analysis and planning into MTNN’s engagements and identify /create distinct competitive advantages for the organization through strategic use of information.
	Lead regulatory analysis, advocacy and advisory support on data privacy, data governance, cross-border data transfers, customer consent, digital identity and responsible use of customer information.
	Provide regulatory leadership on cybersecurity, critical information infrastructure, network resilience, incident reporting, fraud management and security-related obligations affecting telecom operations.
	Advise on artificial intelligence, algorithmic accountability, automated decision-making, AI-enabled customer service, AI-enabled network operations and emerging responsible AI governance frameworks.
	Provide regulatory oversight and business-enablement advice for API-based products, Open Gateway initiatives, interoperability frameworks, platform partnerships and digital ecosystem models.
	Monitor and shape regulatory developments on satellite communications, direct-to-device (D2D), non-terrestrial networks (NTN), spectrum coexistence, emergency connectivity and universal access implications.
	Advise on cloud services, data centres, edge computing, digital infrastructure regulation and technology sovereignty requirements affecting MTNN’s business and partnerships.
	Coordinate cross-functional regulatory impact assessments for new products, services, technologies, partnerships, commercial models and strategic investments before launch or implementation.
	Negotiate interconnects agreements with incumbent operators and new entrants, reviewing interconnect agreements and capacity leasing agreements.
	Negotiate virtual network operator, spectrum leasing, national roaming and active network sharing contracts with other Licensees


Requirements
Education:


	LLB or other recognized law Degree
	First  Degree in any relevant discipline 
	Fluent in English and language of country preferable
	Masters in Business Admin/Masters in Law will be advantageous 


Experience:
A Minimum 12 years of working experience which includes:


	Senior management track record of 3 years or more; with at least 3 years in relevant sector/ industry as per relevant role
	Experience working in a global/multinational enterprise (understanding emerging markets advantageous)
	Worked across diverse cultures and geographies
	Management experience in a commercial legal environment/ within a legal and regulatory control body
	Demonstrable exposure to emerging digital economy regulation, including data privacy, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, digital platforms, APIs, fintech, cloud or satellite communications.
	Experience engaging with senior regulators, government agencies, industry associations and cross-functional executive stakeholders on complex regulatory or public policy matters.

Assistant Manager - B2B Job at Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc




        
    

        
        Flour Mills of Nigeria Plc has been a part of the lives of Nigerians at home and abroad. Our global vision is to be a leading foods company in Africa providing high quality and affordable products in the most convenient ways to consumers through world class brands like Golden Penny Flour, Golden Penny Semovita, Goldenvita, Golden Pasta and Golden Noodles. The Company's flagship brand, Golden Penny, remains one of the best known and the preferred brands amongst bakers, confectioneries and consumers in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Manager - B2B 

Job Location: Lagos

Purpose
     

            
    




	To drive the achievement of assigned brands/category’s performance targets (awareness, loyalty, and volume) through the execution of effective sales, marketing and brand-building strategies and initiatives. 


The Job  


	Market place knowledge, insight generation, regional category plans development and execution for B2B sales 
	Event ownership, activations & management: Collaborate with the Sales and Marketing teams on the planning, monitoring, and execution of promotional activities and events to drive value creation, improve brand performance, and achieve sales objectives in the marketplace 
	Channel development – strengthen existing B2B sales channels and develop new adjacent channels to improve performance via insight generation and execution of strategies  
	Monitor and ensure the effective utilization of the marketing budget by tracking expenditures and supporting the development and implementation of marketing tactics that drive volume, market share, profitability, and overall business performance targets. 
	Oversee the design and development of promotional materials and support the development of promotional strategies to enhance brand awareness, trial, preference, usage, and loyalty while ensuring alignment with overall marketing objectives and brand positioning 
	Measure and report performance of all sales and marketing events for assigned brands and assess against set performance goals (ROI and KPIs) 
	Support the development of insight-driven (Above-the-Line) ATL marketing communications. 


Qualification


	HND/B.Sc. in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or any related discipline. 


Experience:


	Minimum of three (3) years of relevant sales experience within the FMCG industry, preferably in redistribution sales.


The Person Must: 


	Have strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
	Possess strong leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 
	Demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
	Be proficient in leveraging data and sales insights to improve trade execution and business performance.

Business Development Officer Job at Mao-Oak Resources Limited




        
    

        
        Mao-Oak Resources Limited, incorporated in 2017, is wholly Nigerian company strategically positioned to offer Oil & Gas Services, Turnkey Project Consultancy, Offshore Safety, General Procurement and Marine Fire Solutions with key expertise across Marine, Oil & Gas and Aviation Operations. We collaborate with a global network of strategic partners to seamlessly deploy cutting-edge technologies, ensuring innovative solutions and guaranteed client satisfaction.

Since more than 7 years in Nigeria, and with permanent facility in Port-Harcourt, Mao-Oak Resource Ltd combines its multidisciplinary expertise, mobilization capacity on appropriate infrastructures and innovative equipment to provide integrated solutions, always with a local content optimization approach.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Officer 

Job Location: Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing client relationships, and driving revenue growth within the oil and gas sector.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new clients, contracts, and business opportunities.
	Build and maintain relationships with oil & gas companies, EPC contractors, and industry stakeholders.
	Prepare and follow up on quotations, tenders, proposals, and business presentations.
	Monitor industry trends, tenders, and market opportunities.
	Collaborate with Procurement and Operations teams to develop competitive solutions.
	Maintain accurate records of business development activities and client engagements.
	Achieve agreed business development and sales targets.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
	1–3 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or a related role, preferably in Oil & Gas/EPC.
	Strong communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-management skills.
	Knowledge of the Nigerian Oil & Gas industry and tendering processes is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using  Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Hotel Procurement Personnel Job at Hotel Capitol




        
    

        
        Hotel Capitol is a modern and contemporary hotel that offers not only luxury but comfort at its best. The three-star hotel is strategically located at the heart of Omole Phase 1, making it easily accessible with excellent road networks to other parts of the mainland and the city of Lagos as a whole. The 32-room Hotel offers tastefully furnished deluxe executive and super executive rooms as well as one- and two-bedroom luxury suites.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Hotel Procurement Personnel

Job Location: Berger, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Procurement Officer is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and managing supplies, equipment, and services required for hotel operations.
	The role ensures cost-effectiveness, quality compliance, timely delivery, and proper documentation in line with hotel policies.


Key Responsibilities


	Source and purchase food items, beverages, housekeeping materials, maintenance supplies, and office consumables.
	Identify reliable vendors and negotiate prices, terms, and delivery schedules.
	Prepare and process purchase orders in line with approved budgets.
	Ensure timely delivery of goods and confirm quality and quantity upon receipt.
	Maintain accurate procurement records, invoices, and supplier documentation.
	Monitor stock levels and work closely with storekeepers to prevent shortages or overstocking.
	Conduct market surveys to ensure competitive pricing.
	Handle vendor relationships and resolve supply-related issues.
	Ensure compliance with hotel procurement policies and internal controls.
	Support periodic audits by providing procurement records.
	Coordinate with kitchen, housekeeping, maintenance, and front desk departments on supply needs.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Minimum of OND in Procurement or relevant discipline,
	2–5 years in procurement, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment.
	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Good knowledge of local suppliers and markets.
	Excellent record-keeping and documentation skills.
	Basic accounting and inventory management knowledge.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word).
	High level of integrity and accountability.


Key Skills & Competencies:


	Attention to detail
	Cost control and budgeting
	Communication and interpersonal skills
	Time management
	Problem-solving ability
	Ability to work under pressure
	Proximity to the work location; Ogba, Agege, Ikeja, Ojota, Ojodu Berger, and Akute axis.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Content Developer Job at Corporately Lucid




        
    

        
        Corporately Lucid helps impactful brands overcome the inability to gain the right attention.Most brands do impactful work and stand for something great but do not know how to articulate such so it gets to the right audience. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Content Developer
Job Location: Nigeria
Employment Type: Full-time (Remote) 

About the Role


	This role is a full-time role, and the content developer is responsible for creating content for different purposes at our company and for our clients.
	In addition, they may be required to perform certain responsibilities related to creating content for different platforms and to make suggestions to improve the overall content creation process.


Job Description


	As a Content Developer, you will be responsible for creating and managing content that informs, engages, and converts your target audience.
	You will research and write content for various media and purposes, such as online campaigns, websites, videos, podcasts, and social media.
	Also, you will optimize your content for search engines and user experience.
	Your job requires you to work closely with other team members and departments to develop content strategies that align with your company’s goals and our clients' brand identities.

Responsibilities


	Conduct thorough research on industry-related topics and generate ideas for new content types.
	Write clear, concise, and compelling copy to promote clients’ brands.
	Prepare well-structured drafts using content management systems.
	Edit and proofread content before sending it out for further work.
	Ensure consistency in style, tone, and voice across all content channels for each brand.
	Optimize content for search engines and user experience when writing blog articles.
	Distribute content through various platforms, such as social media, email, or the web.
	Work with feedback from various stakeholders and use it to make improvements as needed.
	Create social media calendars, including copy and captions.
